instruction_units.title: 1. Octave-Doubled Melody
instruction_units.instruction: The right hand projects an octave-doubled melody on m.61, beat 1.5 as one structural unit: 4 doubled octaves ascending (span 19 semitones, mixed_octave_plus_other_tones).

instruction_units.title: 2. LH Leap To Chord
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand moves from Gb2 on m.60, beat 1 to an Db3-Gb3-Bb3-Db4 chord on m.60, beat 1.5.

instruction_units.title: 3. Melody with accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: Both hands form a melody-with-accompaniment texture at m.58: one layer carries the melodic line while another supplies aligned support. Melody Bb4-Eb5 over accompaniment Bb3.
